name: Tail Sweep (Combat)
body:
Your tail is equally good at tripping opponents as it is at hurting them.

Prerequisite(s): Whiptail (Combat), base attack bonus +6, gnorri.

Benefit(s): When you make an attack with your tail, you can make a trip attempt as a free action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

Normal: You can’t normally make a trip attempt with your tail.
